about: OPS-33 house portfolio signing keys: public halves only. A house manifest's signature { alg: 'ed25519', keyId, sig } is the ed25519 signature over the 32 raw bytes of its manifestSha256; scripts/house_portfolio.cjs verifies every signature it makes against the entry for its keyId here before anything is written (HOUSE_SIGNING_KEY_MISMATCH otherwise). spkiDerSha256 is the lower-case hex SHA-256 of the key's SPKI DER bytes. The private key lives only in Secret Manager and is never committed.
